shortDescription: MIDLAND, Mich., Oct. 15, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Dow (NYSE:DOW) has declared a dividend of 35 cents per share, payable December 11, 2026, to shareholders of record on November 30, 2026.This marks the 461st consecutive dividend paid by the Company or its affiliates since 1912.About DowDow (NYSE:DOW) is…
